responsibility: This header declares the helper entry point for invoking GCC’s RTL pass pipeline directly from an already-built RTL function. It exposes run_rtl_passes so front-end, testing, or debugging code can request execution of the backend passes beginning at a named initial pass.
same_name_distinction: Declares the run_rtl_passes entry point for invoking backend RTL passes on an existing RTL function body, while run-rtl-passes.cc contains the orchestration logic.
